cells.gaps: No source from the last three years shows the universal service fund collecting money or paying for a project: its last held project is on a page of 3 October 2023. The 2024/25 spending figure comes from estimates published before that year began.
cells.note: Stage 3 because the digital lines held for both years rose 14.8% for 2026/27. Not stage 4, because the fund's only evidence of paying, a page of 3 October 2023, is now past three years and no longer shows it acting.
